arc.name: DON'T WAKE HER: Ending "What Never Wakes" (Part 4: Right Above You / Part 5: Wake Her)
arc.part4:
DON'T WAKE HER, Part 4: Right Above You
Clock runs 12:03 to 12:05 AM. Every monitor stamp is the clock minus ten minutes. Every cctv stamp is the clock.

COLD OPEN (about 2.5 s, before beat #0): taken from beat #12 (cctv_grid). Narration that plays: "Slowly. Down. Toward you." (4 words). Label: "12:05 AM". Visual: HALE CAMS • LIVE with the NURSERY feed full screen and a red alert frame. The SHAPE is bent over the crib with its finger to its face. Its neck line bends and the head tilts down toward the floor while the red eyes flare. Hard glitch cut (RGB split, static, 4 black frames) at the instant the eyes point straight down. Then beat #0 starts.

#0 12:03 AM bedroom: you on the bed, the door open, the SHAPE gone.
 Narration: The thing that whispered in your ear just climbed the stairs to Wren.
#1 12:03 AM bedroom: the camera tilts up to the ceiling. The dashed crib outline sits directly above the bed, with small creak lines pulsing right over it.
 Narration: Above you, the floor creaks. Right over her crib.
#2 12:03 AM monitor_screen: CAM - NURSERY, stamp 11:53 PM, muted icon. Quiet nursery: Wren, the closet open a crack, no SHAPE.
 Narration: Your monitor is no help. It's still showing eleven fifty-three.
#3 12:03 AM phone_chat (Mrs. Hale, "Active now"): a photo bubble shows a live NURSERY still, stamp 12:03 AM, with the SHAPE bent over the crib.
 Narration: But Mrs. Hale is watching live. She texts: "It's bent over her crib."
 MRS. HALE = "It's bent over her crib."
#4 12:04 AM phone_chat (Mr. Hale):
 Narration: Mr. Hale writes: "Ten minutes away. Do not go up there."
 MR. HALE = "Ten minutes away. Do not go up there."
#5 12:04 AM cctv_grid: HALE CAMS • LIVE, stamp 12:04 AM. NURSERY grows to full screen with a red alert frame. The SHAPE hunches lower over the crib in the finger pose.
 Narration: On Mrs. Hale's feed, it bends lower. Finger to its face.
#6 12:04 AM phone_lock: the two old notifications replay one at a time, "Mr. Hale · 11:53 – Hallway cam caught you at eleven fifty. Then motion at…" and then "Mrs. Hale · 12:01 – sent a photo". A red "SHHH." flashes after each one.
 Narration: Then it clicks. Your phone buzzed. It hushed you. Your phone buzzed again. It hushed you again.
#7 12:04 AM face_closeup: lit from below, your eyes slowly roll up toward the ceiling.
 Narration: It never told you to leave. It told you to be quiet.
#8 12:04 AM rule_card: label "ITS RULE, NOT YOURS", text "DON'T WAKE HER.", sub "WHAT IF SHE WAKES?"
 Narration: It needs her asleep. So what happens if she wakes up?
#9 12:05 AM bedroom: tilt to the ceiling. The dashed crib sits exactly above the bed, and a thin red dashed line drops from the crib to your head.
 Narration: You don't have to go up there. She's right above you.
#10 12:05 AM bedroom: you stand on the bed (stand pose) with your fist raised an inch under the dashed crib.
 Narration: You stand on the bed. Your fist, right under her crib.
#11 12:05 AM phone_lock: a buzz, then a red notification "Mrs. Hale – Wake her up."
 Narration: Your phone buzzes. Mrs. Hale sees you on the guest cam. "Wake her up."
 MRS. HALE = "Wake her up."
#12 12:05 AM cctv_grid: NURSERY full screen, red alert frame, stamp 12:05 AM. The SHAPE's neck bends and its head turns slowly down toward the floor, toward the room below. Red eyes flare and red rings tighten. (This is the source of the cold open.)
 Narration: On her live feed, its head turns. Slowly. Down. Toward you.
#13 12:05 AM sfx_text: lines ["DON'T", "WAKE HER."]. Very low breathy whisper coming from above, centered rather than panned.
 Narration: Through the ceiling, a whisper: "Don't wake her."
 THE SHAPE = "Don't wake her."
#14 12:05 AM choice_split: title "Would you wake her?", kicker "IT SAYS DON'T. HER MOM SAYS DO.", a "Wake|her", b "Let her|sleep".
 Narration: Would you wake her? Tell me in the comments.
#15 12:05 AM end_card: title "DON'T WAKE HER", kicker "PART 4", pill "FOLLOW FOR THE FINALE", sub "WAKE HER OR LET HER SLEEP?|TELL ME IN THE COMMENTS".
 Narration: Follow for the finale.

WORD COUNT: 175 words of narration (beats 0-15: 13/9/10/13/11/11/17/12/11/11/11/14/11/8/9/4). With the 4 repeated cold-open words it is 179. At about 2.2 words/s, like Parts 1-3, it runs roughly 80 s.
ENDING: CLIFFHANGER. The pattern is now clear: every phone buzz brought a "Shhh". It never told you to leave, only to be quiet, so it needs Wren asleep. Mr. Hale says "Do not go up there", and you don't have to, because the dashed crib is right above your bed. You stand on the bed with your fist under the crib. Mrs. Hale texts "Wake her up." That buzz turns the SHAPE's head on the live feed down through the floor toward you, and through the ceiling comes "Don't wake her." The engagement prompt is "Would you wake her? Tell me in the comments." followed by "Follow for the finale." The new scenes are not used yet.

arc.part5:
DON'T WAKE HER, Part 5: Wake Her (FINALE)
Clock runs 12:05 to 12:16 AM. Monitor stamps are the clock minus ten minutes, and cctv stamps are the clock. This part uses the two allowed new scene types: nursery_pov (#7) and front_door (#8).

COLD OPEN (about 2 s, before beat #0): taken from beat #14 (monitor_screen). Narration that plays: "From inside the closet," (4 words). Label: "LATER". Visual: the old monitor handset showing CAM - NURSERY, stamp 12:06 AM, with the closet door fully shut. The muted icon blinks off and red rings tighten on the closet door. On the first breath of the whisper there is a hard glitch cut to black. The whisper's words are NOT heard in the cold open, so the sting stays saved for the end. Then beat #0.

#0 12:05 AM bedroom: tilt to the ceiling, your fist under the dashed crib outline.
 Narration: It's standing over Wren, and it just told you not to wake her.
#1 12:05 AM face_closeup: lit from below, eyes up.
 Narration: So you do the one thing every babysitter is told never to do.
#2 12:05 AM bedroom: your fist hits the ceiling right under the dashed crib, and the screen shakes three times.
 Narration: You slam the ceiling. Three times.
#3 12:05 AM bedroom: hold on the ceiling, dead still. Then a red sound ring bursts out of the dashed crib.
 Narration: One second of silence. Then Wren screams.
#4 12:05 AM cctv_grid: NURSERY full screen, red alert frame, stamp 12:05 AM. The SHAPE jerks upright with its head at the ceiling line and recoils away from the crib.
 Narration: On Mrs. Hale's feed, it flinches back from the crib. From the noise.
#5 12:06 AM cctv_grid: stamp 12:06 AM. It folds itself into the closet and the door swings fully shut, leaving no gap for the first time. The red frame drops.
 Narration: It folds into the closet. The door that never shuts right clicks shut.
#6 12:06 AM phone_chat (Mrs. Hale, "Active now"):
 Narration: Mrs. Hale types: "Don't let her fall asleep."
 MRS. HALE = "Don't let her fall asleep."
#7 12:07 AM nursery_pov: your own eyes, no camera and no timestamp. The lights snap on to show the crib with crying lines (Wren never shown close up and never touched), the mobile, the nightlight and the closet shut tight. Off-key music notes float in the air.
 Narration: You run upstairs. Lights on. You sing, loud and badly, eyes on the closet. She cries. Good.
#8 12:14 AM front_door: headlights sweep through the window and a key turns.
 Narration: Twelve fourteen. Headlights. A key in the door.
#9 12:14 AM hallway: light spreads from behind and you turn toward it.
 Narration: The Hales run in. Wren is safe. Wide awake.
#10 12:15 AM fridge_note: Mrs. Hale's note, with the line "Wren down by eight ♥" slowly glowing red.
 Narration: Mrs. Hale whispers: "She's never woken up at night. Not once."
 MRS. HALE = "She's never woken up at night. Not once."
#11 12:15 AM rule_card: label "WHAT IT IS", text "IT ONLY TAKES WHAT NEVER WAKES.", sub "TONIGHT, SHE WOKE."
 Narration: Not a good sleeper. A hushed one. It only takes what never wakes. Tonight, she woke.
#12 12:15 AM bedroom: label "◀◀ 11:57 PM" with rewind lines. You sit on the bed with your head bowed and eyes shut. The SHAPE stands behind your LEFT shoulder (screen-right) at 50% opacity, bent low, finger to its face.
 Narration: Remember when you shut your eyes? It stood beside you, waiting for you to sleep.
#13 12:16 AM monitor_screen: CAM - NURSERY, stamp 12:06 AM, closet shut. The muted icon disappears.
 Narration: Downstairs, for the first time tonight, you unmute the monitor.
#14 12:16 AM monitor_screen: stamp 12:06 AM, red rings tightening on the closet door, a faint audio waveform. (This is the source of the cold open.)
 Narration: From inside the closet, ten minutes ago:
#15 12:16 AM sfx_text: lines ["SHHH.", "YOUR TURN."]. Very low breathy whisper.
 Narration: "Shhh. Your turn."
 THE SHAPE = "Shhh. Your turn."
#16 12:16 AM end_card: title "DON'T WAKE HER", kicker "PART 5 · FINALE", pill "THE END", sub "HOW LONG COULD YOU STAY AWAKE?|TELL ME IN THE COMMENTS".
 Narration: How long could you stay awake? Tell me in the comments.

WORD COUNT: 180 words of narration (beats 0-16: 13/13/6/7/13/13/8/17/8/9/11/16/15/10/7/3/11). With the 4 repeated cold-open words it is 184. That runs roughly 80 s.
ENDING: RESOLUTION, then STING, then COMMENT QUESTION. You do the forbidden thing and slam the ceiling right under the crib. Wren screams. On the live app the SHAPE recoils, folds into the closet, and the door that "never shuts right" finally clicks shut. You keep Wren awake until 12:14, exactly ten minutes after Mr. Hale's "Ten minutes away". The Hales arrive and Wren is safe and wide awake. Mrs. Hale's "She's never woken up at night. Not once." reveals what the SHAPE is: Wren wasn't a good sleeper, she was a hushed one, and it only takes what never wakes. Tonight she woke, so its hold is broken. The flashback shows it stood beside you while your eyes were shut. In the sting, you unmute the old monitor for the first time and hear, ten minutes late, from inside the shut closet: "Shhh. Your turn." Closing question: "How long could you stay awake?"
arc.what_the_shape_is:
It is a hushing thing that lives in the nursery closet. The closet "never shuts right" because it keeps the door open a crack so it can watch. It is physical and real: every camera sees it, and the monitor only shows it ten minutes late (the clock was never wrong). Every night it bends over a sleeping child with its finger to its face and hushes her a little deeper. It only takes what never wakes, into the closet. That is why Wren "has never woken up at night. Not once." She wasn't a good sleeper. She was a hushed one, and tonight, with the parents gone, it was ready to take her.

"Don't wake her" / "You'll wake her" was never a warning to protect Wren and never a threat against you. It is its own rule, because a single waking breaks its hold, and a child who wakes is no longer one it can take. It never told you to leave, only to be quiet. It wasn't hunting you. It was policing noise. When your phone buzzed at 11:53 it hushed you at 11:54. When your phone buzzed at 12:01 it breathed "Shhh. You'll wake her." While your eyes were shut from 11:54 to 12:00 it stood beside you, waiting for you to fall asleep too, so the whole house would be silent.

That makes the series title its rule, not yours. Breaking it is the solution: you wake her from directly below, the hold snaps, and it retreats into the closet, which shuts all the way for the first time. Its last words, recorded on the muted, delayed monitor, show that it has chosen the one person who once closed their eyes beside it.
arc.plants_used:
Each detail planted in Parts 1-3 and where it pays off:

- 10-minute delay: in P4#2 the monitor is useless, still showing 11:53. Mr. Hale's "Ten minutes away" (P4#4) mirrors the delay and the parents arrive at exactly 12:14 (P5#8). In the sting (P5#13-15) the unmuted monitor plays 12:06 audio at 12:16: "From inside the closet, ten minutes ago". The SHAPE spoke knowing you would hear it ten minutes late.
- The closet / "It never shuts right" / the door open a crack: it is the SHAPE's home and its way of watching. P5#5: "The door that never shuts right clicks shut." P5#7: you sing with your eyes on the closet. P5#14-15: the final whisper comes from inside it.
- Finger to its face (hush pose): P4#5 shows it bending lower with the finger raised. P5#12 shows the same pose beside you while your eyes were shut. Read together, the gesture is its whole nature: keep the house silent.
- "Shhh." (P2) and "Shhh. You'll wake her." (P3): each came right after your phone buzzed (11:53 to 11:54, and 12:01). P4#6-8 turns this into the deduction ("It never told you to leave. It told you to be quiet. It needs her asleep."). P4#13's "Don't wake her." makes the title its rule, and P5#15's "Shhh. Your turn." completes the pattern.
- Muted monitor ("The sound is muted.", the muted icon): never touched until P5#13 ("for the first time tonight, you unmute the monitor"), which delivers the sting.
- Parents' live app (HALE CAMS • LIVE, "Nobody lied"): Mrs. Hale watches live and relays it (P4#3, #5, #12). It shows the SHAPE flinching from the crib and folding into the closet (P5#4-5). It is the only real-time view, against your delayed monitor.
- Guest-room camera: Mrs. Hale "sees you on the guest cam" standing under the crib and texts "Wake her up." (P4#11). That buzz is what turns its head down toward you (P4#12). P5#12 replays the 11:57 guest-room moment with the SHAPE beside you.
- Ceiling creak above you / "Wren sleeps right above you": P4#1 "Above you, the floor creaks. Right over her crib." It locates the SHAPE and the crib directly over your bed.
- Dashed crib outline: this is the key to the fair solution. P4#9 "You don't have to go up there. She's right above you." In P4#10 and P5#0-3 you slam the ceiling right under the outline and wake her from below.
- Fridge note "Wren down by eight ♥" (and the "Clock's wrong" misdirect already paid off in P3): in P5#10 that line glows as Mrs. Hale says "She's never woken up at night. Not once." This is the reveal that Wren was hushed, not a good sleeper.
- "You freeze and shut your eyes" from 11:54 to midnight (P2#13-14), plus the SHAPE over your shoulder at 12:01 (P3#8): P5#12 "It stood beside you, waiting for you to sleep." This sets up the sting fairly.
- Mr. Hale's "Getting Dana" (P2): they left the wedding, which pays off as headlights and a key at 12:14 (P5#8-9).

Production checks: the two new scene types (nursery_pov, front_door) stay within the max of two. Wren is never shown close up or touched. There is no gore, and every number in the narration is written as words.
arc.final_sting:
At 12:16, with the Hales home and Wren safe, you are back alone in the guest room. For the first time all night, you unmute the old monitor. Because it runs ten minutes late, you hear 12:06, the moment the closet that "never shuts right" finally clicked shut. Under Wren's crying, very low and breathy, comes a whisper from inside the closet: "Shhh. Your turn." It knew about the delay, it knew you would be the one listening, and it already stood beside you once while your eyes were shut. Then the end card: "How long could you stay awake? Tell me in the comments."

The sting does not undo the resolution. Wren woke, and it only takes what never wakes, so its hold on her is broken. The parents are home and the explanation stands. The threat now points only at you, the babysitter who has been awake all night, which quietly turns the title "Don't wake her" into "don't fall asleep" without anyone saying it.

The Part 5 cold open teases this moment: "From inside the closet," with the red rings on the closet door, cut on the first breath. Viewers have to watch to the end to hear what it said.

part4.ending:
CLIFFHANGER. You climb the stairs in your head, not on your feet. On Mrs. Hale's live feed the SHAPE is back over Wren's crib, while your muted monitor still shows 11:53, the minute it was downstairs with you. Mr. Hale is "Ten minutes away" and says "Do not go up there." Then you see the pattern: every buzz, it hushed you (the 11:53 buzz, then "Shhh." at 11:54; the 12:01 buzz, then "Shhh. You'll wake her."). It never told you to leave, only to be quiet, so it needs Wren asleep. You don't have to go up, because the dashed crib is right above your bed. You stand on the bed with your fist under her crib. Your phone buzzes, too loud. Mrs. Hale has just watched it hushing her baby, now sees you on the guest cam, and texts "Wake her up." Right after that buzz, the SHAPE's head on the live feed tilts slowly down. Its eyes slide to the bottom of its head, and a red dashed sight-line drops through the floor toward you. Through the ceiling comes "Don't wake her." ENGAGEMENT: "Would you wake her? Tell me in the comments." on a choice card (IT SAYS DON'T. HER MOM SAYS DO.), then "Follow for the finale."

COLD OPEN SPEC (Part 4): the source is beat index 12 (0-based in the main script, cold-open entry not counted), which is beats[13] in this array. Words: "Slowly. Down. Toward you." part5.ending:
RESOLUTION, THEN STING, THEN COMMENT QUESTION.

Resolution: Part 4 ended with the SHAPE's head on the live feed tilted down toward you, a red dashed sight-line dropping from its eyes through the floor, and "Don't wake her." coming through the ceiling. You do the forbidden thing and slam the ceiling three times, right under the dashed crib. After one second of silence, Wren screams. On Mrs. Hale's live feed the SHAPE flinches from the crib and from the noise. It folds into the closet, and the door that "never shuts right" clicks fully shut for the first time in the series. Mrs. Hale, who watched it happen live, texts "Don't let her fall asleep." You run upstairs, switch the lights on, and sing loudly and badly with your eyes on the shut closet. About four seconds in, Wren's crying stops for half a second, one slat creaks and a red ring pulses on the seam. You sing louder and the crying comes back.

At twelve fourteen, exactly ten minutes after Mr. Hale's "Ten minutes away" at 12:04, headlights sweep the window and a key turns. The Hales run in. Wren is safe. Nobody opens the closet. The avoidance is deliberate, and through the nursery doorway a faint red ring still pulses on its seam.

Reveal: Mrs. Hale whispers "She's never woken up at night. Not once." A rewind shows Wren lying perfectly still through everything tonight: the SHAPE's hush, your two waves, the closet opening. The rule card then explains what the SHAPE is. Wren was never a good sleeper. She was a hushed one, and "It only takes what never wakes." Tonight she woke, so its hold on her is broken. "Don't wake her" was always its rule, never yours. All through the explanation, the handset's muted icon keeps blinking in a corner of the frame (beats[11] and beats[13]), so the open loop stays visible.

A flashback to 11:57, when your eyes were shut, shows the SHAPE standing beside you, "waiting for you to sleep too." That explains why it had not taken Wren earlier in the night: it needed the whole house silent.

Sting: at 12:16 you are alone downstairs, packing up to leave, and you finally unmute the old monitor. Because the monitor runs ten minutes late, you hear 12:06, the moment the closet had just shut. A red eye glints between the slats, looking straight into the monitor lens at you and the viewer. From inside the closet comes "Shhh. Your turn." On the end card, one slow breath comes from behind your left shoulder, the same cue as Parts 2 and 3: the SHAPE has left Wren's closet and is with you, now. This does not undo the resolution: Wren woke, the parents are home, and the explanation stands. The threat now points only at you, which quietly turns the title into "don't fall asleep." The closing question is "How long could you stay awake? Tell me in the comments."
